newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Bank of Israel resumes daily monetary tenders.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Israel resumes daily monetary tenders.

text.p: The Bank of Israel said on Sunday it had resumed its daily monetary tenders to the commercial banks after a 17-day break.
The central bank said it had tendered 2.8 billion shekels against demand of 23.4 billion shekels at an average rate of interest of 15.21 percent.

In recent months, the Bank of Israel has been suspending the daily tenders in the first half of the month, when the banking system has excess liquidity, and renewing them in the second half. The bank's weekly tender, however, was suspended in July and has not been renewed.
